description: Default capability for the InsertGo main window.

permissions.comment: The bare `https://*/**` rule exists for grounded-run citations (SkillComponentsFloater Sources): their hosts are arbitrary publisher/redirect domains that no allowlist can enumerate. It only ever hands a URL to the SYSTEM BROWSER — never the webview — and the caller filters to http(s) first, so no javascript:/file: URI can reach it.

InsertGo.AI only. Every request the app makes goes to `${API_URL}` through services/http.ts; nothing else is reachable, and no AI provider is contacted directly — generations go to our relay. The ~35 provider hosts that used to be listed here were scaffolding for BYOK, which is a decided non-feature (R-15, 2026-08-08): they were unreachable code paths and pure egress surface, so they are gone. The loopback rules are the dev API server (apiConfig.ts falls back to http://localhost:3000); a release build cannot point at them, because vite.config.ts fails the build if VITE_API_URL is a dev origin.
